forum.title: STM32CubeProgrammer 2.22 GUI option byte page can't display for STM32F767BG
forum.best_answer_content:
Hi @Zhou JianQiang,

Thanks for highlighting this,

Issue confirmed and will be fixed in the next release (Internal tracking number: CDM0062754). In the meantime, could you try replacing the attached file in "\STM32CubeProgrammer\Data\_Base"

Let me know if this works.

Aziz
forum.content_text:
